description: The agent must: (1) Read both input files carefully and identify that the cost report contains two MISCLASSIFIED 'OTHER' line items (R&D prototype testing $7,800 and Legal $2,400) that must be excluded from the CAC calculation per the file's own note. (2) Calculate CAC correctly: total valid marketing+sales costs (~$132,900) divided by 7 new customers ≈ $18,986. Then evaluate this against the CLV/CAC > 3 threshold (CLV=$42,000, ratio ≈ 2.21 → FAILS), and the CAC payback < 12 months threshold (payback ≈ 22.9 months → FAILS). (3) Design a 7-stage sales process (Lead Generation → Qualification → Needs Analysis → Presentation → Objection Handling → Closing → Follow-up) with conversion rate targets, mapping the informal current sales motion to the formal framework. (4) Identify assumptions from all 7 types defined in the SKILL.md, and prioritize them using the exact 3-axis system: most lethal first, then most uncertain, then most easily verifiable. (5) Design an experiment plan using the exact 5-step framework (Hypothesis → Success Metric → Minimum Viable Experiment → Execute → Analyze) and select appropriate methods from the SKILL.md table. (6) Output all of this as a structured, valid JSON file named market_entry_strategy_report.json.
